title_en: Never pour your own soju in Korea #shorts
description_en: Korean drinking manners in 30 seconds: pour for each other, use two hands with elders, and turn your head when you drink.
hook_en: Pouring your own soju? Not in Korea.
hook_vi: Tự rót soju cho mình? Ở Hàn Quốc thì không nhé.
hook_id: Tuang soju sendiri? Jangan di Korea.
hook_es: ¿Te sirves tu propio soju? En Corea, no.
hook_pt: Servir seu próprio soju? Na Coreia, não.
hook_ar: تصبّ السوجو لنفسك؟ ليس في كوريا.
hook_fil: Ikaw ang magbubuhos ng soju mo? Hindi sa Korea.
hook_voice: Pouring your own soju? Not in Korea.

scenes.voice: In Korea, you pour for others, and they pour for you. Han jan haseyo.
When an older person pours, hold your glass with two hands. Du soneuro.

scenes.vi: Quay đầu sang bên khi uống
scenes.voice: With elders, many Koreans turn their head slightly away when they drink.

cta.voice: And then, geonbae! Follow for one Korean phrase a day.
